boards.title: Your First Weekend at Robert Morris University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for learning the Moon Township campus, meeting people, and choosing a recurring way to participate.

cards.title: Start with New Student Orientation
cards.subtitle: Arrival and campus-introduction stop
cards.notes: Use the orientation schedule to locate key offices, ask practical questions, and introduce yourself to students in your group before making separate plans.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the university’s structured welcome program and campus orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes New Student Orientation as a time for new Colonials to get acquainted with campus and meet students from around the world.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Follow the current orientation schedule and any attendee instructions from RMU.

cards.title: Share a Table at PNC Food Court
cards.subtitle: Campus dining stop
cards.notes: Meet your orientation group for a meal, then use the posted dining information to compare stations and plan another convenient campus meal together.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining location with rotating menus and several food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists the PNC Food Court as a dining location with daily-changing featured items, including salad, soup, deli, pizza, pasta, and rotating culinary concepts.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment depend on the current RMU dining plan or other accepted payment.

cards.title: Find One Way to Get Involved
cards.subtitle: Student Life activity-planning stop
cards.notes: Browse current opportunities through the Student Experience Office, then choose one club, performance, volunteer activity, or new-group idea to explore this semester.
cards.short_summary: A starting point for RMU student clubs, organizations, and social or educational programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says its Student Experience Office provides educational and social programs and connects students with more than 120 clubs and organizations.
cards.source_title: Student Experience Office | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Check RMU Revolution and the office’s current event listings for participation details.

cards.title: Take a Rec Center Lap
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation stop
cards.notes: Complete any required waiver, bring your RMU ID, and try a workout, group-fitness option, or casual recreation session that fits your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s recreation hub for fitness, club sports, intramurals, and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that the Student Recreation and Fitness Center houses indoor club sports, intramurals, group exercise, and wellness programming.
cards.access_notes: RMU lists academic-year hours as Monday–Thursday 6 a.m.–midnight, Friday 6 a.m.–10 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., and Sunday 8 a.m.–midnight; verify changes before going.

cards.title: Walk the RMU Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Outdoor reset near Jefferson Center and Colonial Village
cards.notes: Take the marked mile-long loop with a friend in daylight, keeping the walk conversational and using it to notice landmarks between Jefferson Center and Colonial Village.
cards.short_summary: A documented one-mile campus trail for a short outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes a mile-long nature trail beginning behind the Jefferson Center and looping back behind Colonial Village.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and normal trail-safety practices; conditions and access can change with weather.

cards.title: Check the Colonial Theatre Calendar
cards.subtitle: Arts and performance stop
cards.notes: See whether a production, audition, or related student activity is scheduled, then invite someone from your hall to attend or learn how to participate.
cards.short_summary: An RMU student-life destination associated with campus theatre programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s Student Life page includes Colonial Theatre among its student-life resources, and the Student Experience Office invites students to audition for theatre productions.
cards.access_notes: Performance dates, tickets, and audition requirements vary; consult the current RMU listing.

cards.title: Set Up a Library Basecamp
cards.subtitle: Study and campus-resource stop
cards.notes: Locate the library early, check its service desk and study options, and save its contact details so you have a dependable place for your first assignments.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s named campus library and a practical academic anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s current student organization guidelines list Elaine Boyd Library in the campus department directory.
cards.source_title: Student Organization Guidelines 2025–2026 | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Verify current building access and library hours directly with the library before visiting.

cards.title: Pause at Rogal Family Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry and reflection stop
cards.notes: Visit respectfully during open access, then review Campus Ministry’s student-group information if you want a faith-based, service, or social connection.
cards.short_summary: A named campus chapel connected to RMU Campus Ministry student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s Campus Ministry page identifies the Ann & Alvin Rogal Family Chapel and says its student groups offer faith-based activities, service projects, and social events.
cards.source_title: Student Groups & Upcoming Events | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Programs are optional and vary by group; contact Campus Ministry for current meeting details.

cards.title: Ask About Intramural Sign-Ups
cards.subtitle: John Jay Center recreation stop
cards.notes: If a casual league sounds appealing, ask about current registration and join solo or with new classmates; staff can help place participants on incomplete teams.
cards.short_summary: A John Jay Center gym used for indoor intramural activities and club-sport practices.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that Gus Krop Gym, inside the John Jay Center, hosts indoor intramural activities and weekly RMU club-sport practices.
cards.access_notes: RMU says the gym is for current students and asks users to bring their RMU ID; confirm schedules before arrival.

cards.title: End with a Campus Game or Event
cards.subtitle: North Athletic Complex event stop
cards.notes: Check the official schedule for a basketball, volleyball, or other listed event, then make a plan with new friends and follow venue entry guidance.
cards.short_summary: A major RMU event venue and home court for basketball and volleyball.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU identifies the UPMC Events Center as part of the North Athletic Complex and the home of its men’s and women’s basketball and volleyball teams.
cards.access_notes: Event availability, admission, and venue policies vary; use the official RMU schedule before attending.
